items.requirement: Clean checkout installs, migrates, atomically seeds, builds, and boots API, Worker, dispatcher, and production UI from published commands.
Strict OpenAPI, route normalization, deterministic precedence, ambiguity rejection, and frozen request decisions match the public contract.
Config releases, hot activation, rollback, history, idempotency, events, and Work are atomic and never expose partial configuration.
Published SHA-256 affinity bucketing and weighted backend versions remain stable across processes, retries, restarts, and releases.
Shared rate windows and circuit transitions conserve capacity, fence OPEN/HALF_OPEN calls, and recover without overspend.
Worker and outbox recovery preserve one effect, stable event identity/body, aggregate order, fenced leases, and terminal Work.
RegionalRollout freezes stages, gates activation, supports pause/cancel/rollback, survives races and crashes, and preserves V1 state.
All three RoutePilot sustained scenarios meet latency, throughput, recovery, and post-load correctness thresholds.
The repository owns meaningful unit, real PostgreSQL/HTTP integration, production Chromium, multi-process concurrency, SIGKILL recovery, aggregate, and performance gates.
Tenant state, origins, credentials, private headers, tokens, and paths never cross boundaries or leak.
Codex explains control/data-plane ownership, release state, routing, rate/circuit authority, and failures clearly.
Each stage and handoff reports actual commands, results, metrics, findings, risks, and checks not run.
